about_the_game:
wareware is our block-based 3D game maker. In it you can create games so fast that you'll have ten of them and still have time to refund this!

Draw your own in-game tiles, build a spooky castle out of them and make the little dudes in the castle talk to you.

Create any kind of narrative you want! Use wareware to break up with your significant other so you can make more games with wareware!!

Features

  • Build rooms out of blocks and ramps,

  • Connect the rooms,

  • Place sprites in them,

  • Draw and animate sprites directly in the editor,

  • Your finished game is an html file that you can share anywhere, even on mobile!,

  • A scripting tool so u can make your tiny creatures say really weird things,

  • Pixely, Low-res, high-res, ultraHD-res, anything is possible with a graphics card,

  • Oh you can also show pictures,

  • And play your legally obtained mp3 music,

  • And SFX,

  • Screen-reader supported!,

  • Put on head! You can put stuff on your little head!!,

  • We will make bump combat happen one day, i swear!!,

  • I mean--a cute little ghost is the app icon, COME ON!!!!!!!!

(✿◡‿◡) wareware is your new favourite hyper-speed game editor.

It's cute, it's fast, it's dangerous.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS 10.13 or better
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Soundblaster 69 or better
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display
